name: Shreeshay Engineers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Shreeshay Engineers Ltd is in the business of real estate construction and engineering-focused solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Part of DKG group, Company is an  Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC), that provides materials, designing  and contracting capabilities, and construction project management services

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

Company has a low return on equity of 2.05% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 2,371 days.
